changelog:
- Initial release of the DeFi Stablecoin Yield Scanner.
- Scan and rank live stablecoin APYs across major DeFi protocols and chains using the free DeFiLlama pools API.
- Filter by minimum TVL, APY range, and blockchain to avoid low-liquidity and unsustainable pools.
- See breakdowns of APY (base vs reward), pool risk, and other key pool data.
- Designed for passive income strategies, yield farming, treasury management, and capital allocation.
summary: Scan live stablecoin yields across every major DeFi protocol and chain — Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche, and more — using the free DeFiLlama pools API (no API key required). Built for crypto and DeFi users hunting the best USDC, USDT, DAI, and other stablecoin APY without directional trading risk. Filters by minimum TVL to screen out low-liquidity rug risk, filters by APY range to catch unsustainable reward-emission traps, and can scope results to a single chain. Useful for passive income, yield farming, treasury management, and whale-style capital allocation across DeFi protocols like Aave, Pendle, Curve, and Morpho. Complements trading and options skills by covering the non-directional yield side of crypto.
